info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to kill, to die, to leave body

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: ' mIYo mInAti mInIte, hiMsAyAM mIyate NitaH ' (Slo. 16) iti devaH . ' hiMsAtra mftiH ' iti DA.kA.vyA vyAKyAyAm (2.58) .

examples: 'tvAM mftyurdayatAM mA pramezWAH' (aTarva॰8.1.5). mA pramezWAH=mA mfTAH. prapUrva eva sIN mftyumAcazwe na kevalaH, yaTA pramAyuko BavatItyatra. na tasya lomA'pi mIyata ityatra mIyate kzIyate Cidyata ityarTasya darSanAt.
'aTa tadBItayA rAjYyA rakke pramayamAgate' (rAjata॰6.284). pramayo mftyuH.
'na cAkAle pramIyate' (sOndara0 1.15). na pramIyate na prARErviyujyate, na mriyate.
